title: feat: sort model lists by popularity
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a Popular model sort based on distinct successful users over the rolling 7-day stats window.
- Makes Popular the default for official and community model lists.
- Reuses the existing cached model-stats response and keeps unknown popularity values last.
- Includes focused sorting and catalog tests plus a validated Tinybird pipe update.

Fixes #14173

gist.headline: Let the hive decide
gist.blurb: Model lists now lead with the ones people are actually using. Seven days of successful buzzing, turned into a useful default.
gist.summary: Added a Popular sort for official and community model catalogs, ranking models by distinct successful users over the rolling seven-day stats window and making it the default view.
gist.impact: People browsing models will see widely used options first, while models without popularity data remain neatly at the end of the list.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy model-library garden where glowing model cards are arranged by the number of friendly bee visitors around them, making collective usage visible without making it feel like a leaderboard. Polli acts as the observant catalog keeper, sorting cards into a prominent Popular shelf while small code-plants and flowers grow around a retro terminal.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art model-library garden where glowing model cards are sorted onto a lime green (#ecf874) shelf labeled "POPULAR," with tiny visitor marks showing the most-used cards first and unknown cards resting quietly at the end; code-plants sprout from pastel flower pots beside a warm CRT terminal. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wearing tiny librarian glasses and carefully arranging the cards. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
